message: I remember the first time I actually felt prepared for a potential fire. I had finally gotten around to checking my smoke alarms and realized they were all working—what a relief! Then, I sat down with my family to map out our escape plan in case of emergencies. It felt great being the one who was ready, instead of scrambling at the last minute. Anyone else had a moment when you finally felt like you had your act together? I’d love to hear your stories!
